title: The Thera/Santorini theory of Atlantis

tellings.quote: island of Terara and the Santorini eruption was the story behind Atlantis. Well, this happened 900 years before Plato.

plain: A common theory says that the volcanic eruption on Santorini, an island in Greece once called Thera, was the real event behind Plato's story of Atlantis, the lost island civilization. The researcher Randall Carlson brings up the theory on the show and pushes back on it, pointing out that the eruption "happened 900 years before Plato."
